crossRefs.note: The mouth of the righteous is a spring of life, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.
The teaching of the wise is a spring of life, to turn from the snares of death.
Understanding is a fountain of life to one who has it, but the punishment of fools is their folly.
Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water, but a man of understanding will draw it out.
You offspring of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart, the mouth…
but whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never thirst again; but the water that I will give him will…
He who believes in me, as the Scripture has said, from within him will flow rivers of living water.”
But he said this about the Spirit, which those believing in him were to receive. For the Holy Spirit was not yet given…
Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and…
Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.
I will open my mouth in a parable. I will utter dark sayings of old,

translations.web: The words of a man’s mouth are like deep waters. The fountain of wisdom is like a flowing brook.
translations.bsb: The words of a man’s mouth are deep waters; the fountain of wisdom is a bubbling brook.
translations.kjv: The words of a man's mouth are as deep waters, and the wellspring of wisdom as a flowing brook.
translations.asv: The words of a man's mouth are as deep waters; The wellspring of wisdom is as a flowing brook.
